pages.title: Home
pages.description: Frame the conference brand and drive visitor registration.

sections.intent: Set the conference identity with key date, name, and tagline.
sections.reason: A multi-session conference hub needs immediate recognition and urgency; a banner gives the events team a branded header that anchors every visit.

sections.intent: Push the primary registration action above the fold.
sections.reason: The core goal is registration; a hero-level call-to-action turns brand interest into sign-ups before the visitor scrolls.

sections.intent: Highlight conference stats and headline speakers.
sections.reason: Events teams need social proof and authority signals to trust the hub's value; featured cards for tracks, speaker count, and past attendance build that trust.

sections.intent: Show quotes from past attendees and industry peers.
sections.reason: Multi-track conference buyers look for peer validation; testimonials from events-team peers reduce perceived risk and reinforce the registration decision.

sections.intent: Offer a direct line for group bookings and press inquiries.
sections.reason: Events teams often manage group registrations and need a fast channel that doesn't require navigating away; a footer contact section closes the page with action-ready access.

pages.title: Agenda
pages.description: Display the multi-track timetable so attendees can plan their sessions.

sections.intent: Present the day-by-day schedule with track columns and timings.
sections.reason: A text layout keeps the dense schedule readable and scannable, which is essential when events teams need to compare parallel tracks quickly.

sections.intent: List auxiliary sessions, workshops, and networking slots.
sections.reason: Beyond main tracks, the conference offers add-on experiences; a services section groups them as distinct offerings that deepen the agenda's value.

pages.title: Speakers
pages.description: Showcase speaker profiles to build credibility and excitement.

sections.intent: Display speaker headshots in a browsable grid.
sections.reason: Events teams evaluate conferences by the talent on stage; a gallery makes speaker recognition immediate and visually engaging.

sections.intent: Provide short bios and session affiliations for each speaker.
sections.reason: Bio details connect the person to their session topic, helping attendees choose tracks and trust the expertise behind each talk.

pages.title: Venue
pages.description: Help attendees navigate the venue and plan their stay.

sections.intent: Embed a venue tour video and interactive map.
sections.reason: Logistics confidence drives registration; a media section gives events teams a visual walkthrough of the space and surrounding area.

sections.intent: Detail travel, accommodation, and accessibility information.
sections.reason: Practical logistics text answers the operational questions events teams need resolved before they commit travel budgets.
